verdict.rationale: Inngest documents headless, programmatic operation. Its official CLI lets you inspect runs, fetch traces and invoke functions from the terminal, the REST API covers events and function runs, and a self-hostable server plus a test library support automated pipelines. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g., pipeline examples or non-interactive auth for CI), independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Inspect runs, fetch traces, invoke functions, and give coding agents access to your Inngest data from the terminal.
You do this entirely from the terminal using the Inngest CLI.
The Inngest REST API lets you interact with events, function runs, environments, and more programmatically.
This allows you to mock function state, step tooling, and inputs with a Jest-compatible API supporting all major testing frameworks, runtimes, and libraries
